## TL;DR
The default `github copilot` model (`default` / `copilot-auto-efficiency`) now maps to the Auto `balance` tier, which exists today, and tier rejections from the CLI are turned into plain-English guidance on every failure path. This round fixes review pass 3.

## Work and rationale
- `src/server/agents.ts`: the "engineer turn ended without a handoff" activity line now enriches the stderr part with the Copilot tier guidance (keeping `reason` and `last assistant`), so a tier error no longer shows as raw CLI text there.
- `src/core/copilot-auto-tier.ts`: the guidance never suggests the tier that just failed (a `balance` rejection now says to try `intelligence`), and no longer names a "Settings → Agents" path; it says to open the Agents page and pick a different model.
- Test in `src/ui-app/tests/agent-drivers.test.ts` for the balance-failure case. Earlier rounds on the branch: tier mapping, alias, error mapping in one-shot, review and engineer banners, docs.
- Not changed: `probeError` in `src/core/models.ts` stays raw. It is a model-list probe, not an agent run, so it is out of this task's scope; a follow-up can enrich it.

## Approaches tried
Filtering the failed tier out of both the CLI-suggested list and the built-in fallback list, rather than only one.

## Challenges and blockers
Not verified live: running with `--auto-tier balance` spends Copilot credits and no probe was run.

## Key learnings
Every producer of failure text (one-shot, review, engineer banner, activity line) needs the same enrichment; adding it at each call site was the repeated review finding.
